answer: Let existing members vouch for newcomers, but make each vouch cost the voucher real stake: a copper bond locked behind every introduction. If the newcomer turns out to be a Sybil, the voucher bond is slashed, so vouching for a farm costs the farm own honest-looking members. Like bees sharing nectar, trust flows only through real relationships, and an opal of genuine history behind each voucher is worth more than any number of fresh, unvouched identities.
